text:
jess: Heads up 1: spotted inconsistent naming between Console, quickstart docs panel, and API examples. Console shows 'instance group', quickstart panel says 'allocation bucket' and API snippets use 'serve set'. New users tripping up in the chart labels and onboarding checklist. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/term-mismatch-2.png omar: Oof. Which should we standardize on? Is any term already embedded in telemetry or infra configs? jess: Console + infra currently reference 'instance group'. Docs panel uses 'allocation bucket' in prose and examples. API docs use 'serve set' in code blocks. No infra rename yet, but dashboards reference 'instance_group' metric name. lina: Suggest we converge on one short, user-facing phrase that's unambiguous: I like 'serve set' (matches API and is concise). If we adopt it, we must do aliasing in metrics and add a glossary note so long-time users map old names. mike: From engineering POV 'instance group' is baked into a few endpoints; renaming everywhere is nontrivial. We can surface 'serve set' in UI copy and docs while preserving backend keys. We'll add telemetry aliases and backend compatibility layers. jess: For the quickstart panel microcopy I propose: ```html

Serve set (aka instance group / allocation bucket)

Use Serve sets to control routing, scaling, and billing. Learn more: Serve sets.

``` This keeps the header short and gives the mapping inline for screen readers. lina: UX: please ensure the hover tooltip isn't the only way to see aliases. For keyboard and mobile users the parenthetical mapping must be visible. Also add an info icon that is keyboard-focusable with aria-describedby pointing to the mapping text. mike: Noted. I'll add aria-describedby to the info button and include a fallback visible mapping in the DOM for narrow screens. jess: Docs team: can you also add a banner on the docs landing explaining previous terms? Something like: "Note: 'instance group' and 'allocation bucket' are now surfaced as 'serve set' in the Console and API examples." docs-bot: Created DOCS-5010 (docs glossary + banner) and UX-3090 (console copy). @lina assigned for microcopy review. omar: Telemetry plan: we'll keep metric name instance_group.* but create new aliases serve_set.* that map to the same time series for 90 days. We'll also add a migration note on the metrics dashboard. mike: QA ask: add a visual regression and narrow-width test to assert the quickstart link text doesn't wrap awkwardly. We previously had a truncation bug when the header included parenthetical text. lina: I'll update the mockups and post accessible markup snippets in the design ticket. Also propose a tiny inline glossary CTA in the Console footer: "What's a Serve set?" that opens the docs panel. jess: Rollout plan: docs banner and panel copy patch next week behind a feature flag; Console copy change behind a FF for gradual rollout; telemetry aliases live on deploy day. We'll keep instance_group metric names live for 90 days then revisit. docs-bot: DOCS-5010 and UX-3090 linked to PLAT-6123 (telemetry alias work). omar: I'll send a short PR for telemetry aliasing this afternoon. Mike, can you handle the aria-describedby implementation and the narrow-width test? mike: Yep, will open PR and add unit test. jess: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if any blockers pop up. Close thread after UX-3090 is merged. :rocket:
